bodyPhotoAi.title: Full-body photo and “See it on me”
bodyPhotoAi.body:
Purpose: to generate images that show outfits and shop products on you (“See it on me”).

Data: the full-body photo you upload and the images generated from it. The photo's location and device information is removed in the first processing step after upload.

Who processes it and where: Ala Tech Solutions LTD; the photo is stored on AWS servers in Frankfurt (Germany) and sent to OpenAI (US) to generate the images.

How long: until you delete the photo or the generated images, or your account. The photo and the images are never shown to other users in any setting.

If you do not consent: you cannot use “See it on me”; wardrobe, looks, the stylist and the other features keep working.
bodyPhotoAi.statement: I give my explicit consent to Ala Tech Solutions LTD processing my full-body photo to generate ‘See it on me’ images, and transferring it for that purpose to AWS (Germany) and OpenAI (US).
bodyPhotoAi.summary: To create images that show outfits on your full-length photo.

facePhotoPalette.title: Face photo and colour palette analysis
facePhotoPalette.body:
Purpose: to find the colour season and shades that suit you by looking at the skin, hair and eye colours in your face photo (colour palette analysis).

Data: the face photo you upload and the palette result derived from it (season type, shades that suit you and shades to avoid). No identification, verification or face recognition takes place; no face template that uniquely identifies you is extracted or stored.

Who processes it and where: Ala Tech Solutions LTD; the photo is stored on AWS servers in Frankfurt (Germany) and sent to OpenAI (US) for the analysis.

How long: until you delete the photo or your account. When you delete your face photo, the palette result is deleted too. The photo and the palette are never shown to other users in any setting.

If you do not consent: you cannot use the colour palette analysis; the other features keep working.
facePhotoPalette.statement: I give my explicit consent to Ala Tech Solutions LTD processing my face photo only for colour palette analysis and without identifying me, and transferring it for that purpose to AWS (Germany) and OpenAI (US).
facePhotoPalette.summary: To find the colour palette that suits you from your face photo; no identification.

weight.title: Weight
weight.body:
Purpose: to complete your body profile. Weight is optional.

Data: the weight you enter. It is not sent to the AI provider and is not shown to other users.

Who processes it and where: Ala Tech Solutions LTD; stored on AWS servers in Frankfurt (Germany).

How long: until you remove it or delete your account.

If you do not consent: you leave the weight field empty; no feature is affected.
weight.statement: I give my explicit consent to Ala Tech Solutions LTD storing my weight as part of my body profile.
weight.summary: To keep your weight in your body profile; optional and never sent to the AI.

contacts.title: Finding friends from your contacts
contacts.body:
Purpose: to find people in your contacts who use Droblet.

Data: on your phone, the e-mail addresses in your contacts are turned into SHA-256 hashes with a single-use salt that changes on every request; only these hashes are sent. Names, phone numbers and the e-mail addresses themselves never leave your phone.

Who processes it and where: Ala Tech Solutions LTD; the hashes are held in memory on AWS servers in Frankfurt (Germany) only while the match runs.

How long: the hashes are neither saved nor logged; the salt is deleted after use and expires within 10 minutes at the latest.

If you do not consent: your phone never asks for contacts permission; you can find friends by searching for their username or with an invite link.
contacts.statement: I give my explicit consent to the e-mail addresses in my contacts being turned into hashes on my phone and sent to Ala Tech Solutions LTD to find my friends on Droblet.
contacts.summary: To find your friends on Droblet by sending your contacts’ e-mails as hashes.

marketingNotifications.title: Marketing notifications
marketingNotifications.body:
Purpose: to send notifications that may contain products and offers, such as the weekly edit (looks and products picked by the editor) and price drops on products in your watch list.

Data: your notification preferences, your device's push token, your language and time zone, your watch list.

Who processes it and where: Ala Tech Solutions LTD; notifications are delivered through the Apple Push Notification service on iOS and Google Firebase Cloud Messaging on Android (US).

How long: until you withdraw your consent or delete your account.

If you do not consent: these notifications are not sent. Service notifications such as the morning outfit reminder and follow requests do not depend on this consent and can be switched off one by one.
marketingNotifications.statement: I agree to receive notifications that may contain products and offers, such as the weekly edit and price drops.
marketingNotifications.summary: For notifications that may contain offers, like the weekly edit and price drops.

crossBorderTransfer.title: Transfers abroad
crossBorderTransfer.body:
Purpose: transferring your personal data outside Türkiye to provide the Service, because Droblet is established in the UK and its service providers are abroad.

Data and recipients: your account, profile, wardrobe and usage data to Ala Tech Solutions LTD (UK) and AWS (Germany); your photos and wardrobe attributes to OpenAI (US) for AI processing; your e-mail address to Twilio SendGrid (US); your push token to Apple and Google (US).

Basis: these transfers rely first on the appropriate safeguards in KVKK art. 9 (for example standard contracts). This consent is asked under KVKK art. 9/6-a for incidental transfers where those safeguards are not in place.

How long: until you withdraw your consent or delete your account.

If you do not consent or withdraw: transfers without appropriate safeguards are not made; features that depend on them (for example AI) may not be available.
crossBorderTransfer.statement: I give my explicit consent to my personal data being transferred abroad to the recipients and for the purposes above, in incidental cases where the safeguards of KVKK art. 9 are not in place.
crossBorderTransfer.summary: To transfer your data to providers in the USA for the AI features.

facePhotoTryOn.title: Face photo and “See it on me”
facePhotoTryOn.body:
Purpose: when you have no full-body photo, to build your figure from your face photo together with the body type, height and size you choose, and to generate images that show outfits on that figure (“See it on me”).

Data: the face photo you upload, the body type you choose, your height and size, and the images generated from them. Your weight is not used. No identification, verification or face recognition takes place; no face template that uniquely identifies you is extracted or stored.

Who processes it and where: Ala Tech Solutions LTD; the photo is stored on AWS servers in Frankfurt (Germany) and sent to OpenAI (US) to generate the images.

How long: until you delete the face photo or the generated images, or your account. The photo and the images are never shown to other users in any setting.

If you do not consent: you cannot use “See it on me” without a full-body photo; you can still use it by adding one. The colour palette analysis does not depend on this consent.
facePhotoTryOn.statement: I give my explicit consent to Ala Tech Solutions LTD processing my face photo, together with my body type, height and size and without identifying me, to generate ‘See it on me’ images, and transferring it for that purpose to AWS (Germany) and OpenAI (US).
facePhotoTryOn.summary: To create images of you from your face and the body type you choose, when you have no full-length photo.

review.lead: Each consent is for one purpose and optional. A consent you don’t give only turns that feature off; change it any time in Settings › Privacy.
review.note: No box is ticked for you. “Accept all” ticks them all at once; or continue with just the ones you chose.
review.updatedLead: We added a new purpose: “See it on me” with your face photo. You can choose each consent separately; we ask once.
